facts.fact: Ordinance 2024-950 of 30 October 2024, executed as state law, repeals only Article 50 of law 2013-546 on electronic transactions, which it treats as an existing law.

CIV.note: Ordinance 2017-500 on electronic exchanges with administrations is amended, but no service online is stated.
